title: Capital Flows — X Money ↔ Digital Credit + Margin
notes: v38: X Money flows both ways with Digital Credit (cash → Morpho/BTC engine) and with Margin (1st auto / optional extract). Deploy mid-column still Essential · Fleet · Collateral · Productive · Consumer.

legend.observed: Seen in YNAB/Plaid or expense sheet

income_sources.label: Turo
income_sources.evidence: First-touch ops land X Money. Engine funnel Turo→Digital Credit for capitalization.

income_sources.label: ASICs
income_sources.evidence: Braiins → Digital Credit (Coinbase) every other month.

channels.label: Digital Credit
channels.subtitle: BTC · Morpho · USDC HY
channels.notes: Collapsed Morpho engine: liquidity → BTC spot; LTV cool → USDC HY; LTV hot → HY tops BTC. Also One Card refinance via Morpho principal (~5% vs ~29%).

channels.label: X Money
channels.subtitle: ~6% · ops float
channels.notes: Cash sleeve between Digital Credit and Margin. Bidirectional with both engines: Morpho borrow → X Money and X Money → Digital Credit (fund Morpho/BTC); 1st auto → Margin and optional margin extract back.

channels.label: Margin
channels.subtitle: Agentic · stocks · USDG HY
channels.notes: Collapsed RH equities engine: liquidity → stock spot; margin cool → USDG HY; heat → HY tops stock. Optional extract back to X Money is not income.

channels.label: Collateral
channels.subtitle: Agentic · BTC stack
channels.notes: Deploy sink for free dollars into investable collateral (Agentic / BTC) after Essential + Fleet, before discretionary.

edges.label: borrow → cash
edges.notes: Morpho USDC (and ops surplus) into X Money cash sleeve.

edges.label: cash → DC engine
edges.notes: X Money can fund Digital Credit (Coinbase / Morpho / BTC / USDC HY) — same hub role as X Money → Margin on the equities side.

edges.label: invest collateral
edges.notes: Free dollars into Agentic / BTC collateral after ops floors.

edges.label: 1st auto → equities
edges.notes: Scheduled X Money → RH Agentic; then stock/margin/USDG rotation lives inside Margin card.

edges.label: optional extract
edges.notes: Optional leverage extract to cash — NOT income. Dual-engine risk.
